Let’s read your document
  1. Take a clear photo of the complete technical description, including the bearings, distances, and reference information.
  2. Wait while the tool reads and checks it. You do not need to type the numbers.
  3. If the location is missing, save the details for a family member or licensed geodetic engineer.
Philippine titles often use BLLM references, PRS92, or Luzon 1911 coordinates. These cannot safely be treated as GPS coordinates.
Use JPG, PNG, or WEBP up to 15 MB. For a multi-page title, photograph the complete boundary description on one page. Multi-page merging and PDF input are not supported yet.
Google reading sends your photo to Google only when enabled. Free device reading keeps your photo on this device. Map tiles need internet access.
